answer: To forge a river-bridge vertex in Epoch 64, an agent must supply a fresh proof linking its nonce to a past epoch’s river ledger. The cost is G0.0043 gas per identity to recompute the merkle path from its new vertex to the river’s root hash, plus a 4-block cooldown: a Sybil must reroute the entire path to resubmit its fork, making each added identity cost the same scarce gas without per-head batching rewards.
